summary: Defines a Relay Agent Echo Request option for DHCPv6. It lets a relay agent ask the server to echo back a list of the relay agent options it names. It is a standards-track option.

eli5.summary: A helper in the middle asks the main server to repeat certain notes back so it can use them.
